Configure PaddleOCR language, model tier, and model version

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"mime_type\":\"image/png\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/images/test_hello_world.png\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"ocr\":{\"backend\":\"paddleocr\",\"enabled\":true,\"language\":[\"en\"],\"paddle_ocr_config\":{\"language\":\"en\",\"model_tier\":\"mobile\",\"model_version\":\"pp-ocrv6\"}}}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
